question: Does the CvSU-listed 2014 Labac River presentation provide species evidence that can be used now?

listedWork.titleAsListed: Identification and Characterization of Fish Species in Labac River
listedWork.eventAsListed: Paper presentation at the CvSU Administrative Council, Lasap Hall, CvSU, Indang, Cavite
listedWork.contributorLineAsPrinted: With Panizales, J.N. and Rodil, S.
listedWork.provenance: The entry appears on page 222 of an Area VI Parameter A research listing mirrored by FlipBuilder; the original presentation or report was not available at that page.

access.searchResult: Indexed text reproduced the presentation title, venue and partial contributor line.
access.cvsuLibraryCatalogAttempt: An ordinary public search for Labac River fish at the CvSU Koha catalog timed out after 25 seconds; no result page was read.

queries: exact title plus contributor names Panizales and Rodil
Labac River plus fish and AISAT/CvSU
exact title search excluding the known FlipBuilder listing
targetedPublicFollowupSearch.result: The only result matching the exact presentation title remained the secondary FlipBuilder page 222. No official CvSU presentation file or catalog record was retrieved in these searches.
targetedPublicFollowupSearch.thirdPartyMixedDocumentExcluded: A Scribd result named as an AISAT thesis-format document had contradictory unrelated marketing-thesis material around a Labac fish-study excerpt; it was not treated as the source or used for any study finding.

evidenceAssessment.supported: A secondary research listing points to a 2014 fish-focused presentation with Labac River in its title.
notSupported: Any fish species identity, species count, abundance, or local fish presence
Sampling dates, exact stations/reaches, collection methods, vouchers, and taxonomic validation
Whether the presentation sampled a river reach or the wider Labac-Alemang watershed
Current presence, catchability, water safety, fishing access, or legal rules

rightsAndUse.itemSpecificReuseTerms: Not located; original work not retrieved.
rightsAndUse.decision: Keep as a retrieval lead only. Do not transcribe or publish study results until the original, author/citation details, field evidence, and reuse terms are reviewed.

nextAction: Continue an authorized CvSU library/research-office retrieval path when available; request only bibliographic identity and public/authorized access details. No message or request was sent. Do not infer results from third-party mixed text.
